trigger.description: Read-only memory-drift collection needs the workspace database, and opening it contends on the workspace write lock at .ee/ee.write.lock (another process holds it, e.g. a long batch ingest or index publish). Collection is blocked BEFORE any evidence inspection. Previously this surfaced as memory_drift_source_unverifiable, which wrongly suggested stale memory evidence; the dedicated code states that memory evidence was NOT inspected (details.memoryEvidenceInspected=false, details.sourceFreshness=not_inspected, details.lockAcquisitionClass=workspace_write_lock). memory_drift_source_unverifiable keeps its narrower meaning: evidence WAS inspected and could not be verified. Details are redaction-safe: no lock-holder internals, no stack traces, only the workspace-relative lock path.
setup_commands: hold the workspace write lock from another process (e.g. a long-running ee remember --batch)
